name: Plus 10
author: Addicting Games
description: Plus 10 is a free math and puzzle game. 10 is a pure and holy numerical unit. The base-ten system is something that has revolutionized the world and helped to standardize everything from counting on your fingers to counting on your toes. In plus 10 you will get to experience the thrill and excitement of basic addition as you try to connect disparate numbers floating in the haze and make them add up to ten. If you see a three and a seven then you better try and get them adjacent to each other because when you click on them they add up to ten. If you see a six and a four then you're going to have to move mountains to get them adjacent because when you click on those you'd best believe that's a ten. Plus Ten is a game that will have you scratching your head and picking your brain for a basic combination of numbers that add up to ten. Eight and two, yup that's a ten. Five and another five? Absolutely a ten. The combinations are endless and it's your job to coordinate the exact right drags and clicks in order to make all of these numbers line up, add up, and become ten.
